name: Subnational Energy Transition Index (SETI)
description: This dataset supports the Subnational Energy Transition Index (SETI), an adaptation of the World Economic Forum’s Energy Transition Index to the 27 Brazilian federative units (26 states and the Federal District). It contains the raw indicator data, the min-max normalized values, the hierarchical weighting structure and the resulting scores and rankings, so that every step of the index can be reproduced. SETI combines 33 indicators in two dimensions: System Performance (60%; Equity, Security and Sustainability pillars, one-third each) and Transition Readiness (40%; Regulatory Framework & Investment and Enabling Factors, 50% each). Indicators are normalized to 0–100 (min-max, benefit/cost orientation), weighted through the hierarchy (weight = dimension weight × pillar weight × 1/number of subcategories × 1/number of indicators) and aggregated by weighted linear sum. The regulatory pillar is built from a manual survey of state-level legislative and executive initiatives published in 2023–2024 (normative axis: laws, decrees, resolutions; executive axis: programs, plans, actions), classified by type, energy source, stage of implementation and stance. Data sources: [list agencies, e.g. ANEEL, ANP, EPE/BEN, IBGE, SEEG, ...]. Reference period: [2023–2024]. Spatial coverage: Brazil, 27 federative units. Language: sheet and column names are in Portuguese. Description of files (sheets) Indice_ARTIGO: indicators used in the article (raw values, normalized values and weights).
